description:
Roll dice from standard notation (3d6+2, d20, d%, 4d6kh3 keep highest, 2d20kl1 keep lowest, 4d6dl1 drop lowest, 1d8+1d6-1) with crypto-random, unbiased dice, and get the exact odds: average, standard deviation, most likely totals and, optionally, the chance of every total counted over all face combinations.

Returns: JSON { notation, min, max, rolls[{ total, detail }], odds{ outcomes, mean, sd, mostLikely[], median, table?[{ total, ways, p, atLeast, atMost }], tableNote? }|null }. table is given for up to 1,000 possible totals; above that tableNote explains why it is missing. Dropped dice appear in parentheses in detail; odds is null when the expression has too many combinations to count.
Example input: {"notation":"4d6kh3","rolls":0}
On error, includes hint: Join terms with + or -; keep with kh/kl (4d6kh3), drop with dl/dh (4d6dl1). Set rolls to 0 for odds only and table to true for every total.

notation.description: Dice notation, e.g. '3d6+2', '4d6kh3', '2d20kl1'. Up to 100 dice with 2 to 1000 sides.

rolls.description: How many times to roll (default 1; 0 = odds only).

table.description: Include the chance of every total (exactly, at least, at most), for expressions with up to 1,000 possible totals. Default false.

name: dice_roll
title: Dice roller
